name: 知序小红书运营台
description: Connect WorkBuddy to a Xiaohongshu account matrix for operations overview, lead prioritization, and controlled draft or publish task creation.
description_zh: 将 WorkBuddy 连接到小红书账号矩阵，查询运营概览、识别高意向互动，并创建受控的草稿或发布任务。
examples_zh: 查看小红书账号矩阵中需要优先处理的评论
为山野研究所创建一条徒步路线草稿任务
查看等待浏览器执行的小红书发布任务
examples_en: Show comments that need priority handling in my Xiaohongshu matrix
Create a hiking-route draft task for Mountain Lab
List Xiaohongshu tasks waiting for the browser bridge
